en: The Section on Detailed Exposition, Chapter Eight: Convergence (Sampāta)
In this context, what is the convergence of analytical factors?
It is the verse beginning: “Therefore, for one whose mind is guarded, the range of right intention...”
The side of the wholesome is to be demonstrated by means of the side of the wholesome;
the side of the unwholesome is to be demonstrated by means of the side of the unwholesome.
The section on the Mode of Conveying Analysis is concluded.
